External FFmpeg build is identified, not distributed.

observer.note: The independent GET-only observer again failed at shutdown, as in earlier physical trials; task and cleanup evidence come from the closed audit.

preserved_previous_attempts.change: Wait about 20 s into the first request before the foreground action.
preserved_previous_attempts.summary: The workflow completed end to end, but the scripted F5 was sent 1.9 s into the first request; request plus release took 63 s, so the 60 s input-idle window expired 2 s before parked and the driver timed out.

preserved_previous_attempts.change: Restore the active pointer to the last cleanly stopped owner; the terminated owner record was retained untouched.
preserved_previous_attempts.summary: Cold parking failed closed before any task launched because the engine active pointer still named the native owner terminated by the run-01 supervisor timeout.

scope: One Windows IQ3_S video task responds to an actual foreground Explorer action, parks inference, runs one fixed NVENC operation, loses its first worker (exit 86) before journal completion, and is recovered automatically by the desktop host with a replacement worker that consumes the durable feedback and completes.
